_about: Batch B4b (Models + ops): concepts/oot-models, concepts/model-interfaces, concepts/custom-ops, code/model-executor-custom-op, code/model-executor-models-registry. Owner: the B4b writer. custom-op is in core.json.

model-registry.short: ModelRegistry: the one table per process that maps an architecture name from config.json, such as LlamaForCausalLM, to a model class.
model-registry.long: Built from the tables in {{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1565-1573}}; plugins add entries with register_model ({{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1160-1203}}).

lazy-registration.short: A registry entry that stores only a module name and a class name. vLLM imports the module only when a process needs the class.
lazy-registration.long: register_model with a "module:Class" string makes a _LazyRegisteredModel ({{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1187-1193}}). All built-in entries are lazy.

model-info.short: _ModelInfo: a frozen record of 24 capability values of a model class (generative, pooling, PP, LoRA, multimodal, hybrid ...). The registry computes it from the class.
model-info.long: Fields at {{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:891-915}}; computed by from_model_cls ({{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:917-954}}); cached as JSON in VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/modelinfos.

model-impl.short: The --model-impl setting: auto (vLLM class, else the Transformers backend), vllm, transformers or terratorch.
model-impl.long: Values at {{cite vllm/config/model.py:109}}; used in the lookup order of {{cite vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1351-1402}}.

capability-protocol.short: A class in models/interfaces.py, such as SupportsPP or SupportsLoRA, that a model inherits to say it supports a feature. It brings a ClassVar flag and names the needed methods.
capability-protocol.long: Detected by a supports_* or is_* function, for example {{cite vllm/model_executor/models/interfaces.py:864-897}}.

forward-native.short: The PyTorch-only method of a CustomOp. vLLM calls it when the op is disabled, and the other forward_* methods fall back to it by default.
forward-native.long: Base method at {{cite vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py:136-142}}; disabled path at {{cite vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py:189-192}}.

op-registry.short: op_registry: the dict from a registered op name, such as rms_norm, to its CustomOp or PluggableLayer class. The +name and -name switches use these names.

register-oot.short: The decorator that registers an out-of-tree replacement class for an in-tree CustomOp or PluggableLayer. vLLM then builds the replacement wherever code builds the in-tree class.
register-oot.long: {{cite vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py:334-356}}. A string as the first argument raises TypeError; use name="...".

pluggable-layer.short: A layer base class, for example of the linear layers, that an out-of-tree class can replace as a whole. It has no per-platform forward methods.

ir-op.short: An op of vllm.ir, such as rms_norm: a native PyTorch function with optional kernel providers. A priority list per op selects the provider at call time.
ir-op.long: register_op at {{cite vllm/ir/op.py:102-150}}; dispatch at {{cite vllm/ir/op.py:321-359}}.

kernel-provider.short: A named implementation of an IR op, for example vllm_c, oink, aiter or triton. The name native is reserved for the PyTorch version, and the name unfused is also reserved.
kernel-provider.long: register_impl at {{cite vllm/ir/op.py:240-298}}; reserved names at {{cite vllm/ir/op.py:36}}.
